non_obvious_flags: Norway is in the EEA but NOT the EU — free movement applies via the EEA Agreement.
EEA registration is done with the POLICE (politiet), not the immigration directorate, within 3 months of a >3-month stay.
The registration certificate is NOT proof of right of residence and never needs renewal (register once).
D-number (temporary) vs personnummer (permanent national identity number) is a major distinction.
D-number holders are NOT entitled to a fastlege (GP) — the GP right requires resident registration (personnummer).
Applying for a tax deduction card auto-enrolls a new arrival in the PAYE flat-tax scheme (25% / 17.4% if NI-exempt) up to NOK 725,050 (2026).
